sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 0.8B is the smallest vision-language model in the Qwen3.5 lineup. It is designed for lightweight local multimodal inference, fast iteration, and efficient Jetson deployment.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: About Qwen3.5-0.8B Qwen3.5-0.8B is Alibaba Cloud's ultra-compact multimodal foundation model with 0.8B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in a 6× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern.
